summary: PayPay Corp filed a Form 6-K as a foreign private issuer, reporting its fourth quarter and full year financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains standard earnings disclosures, including total revenue of ¥102.2 billion for the quarter (up 30% YoY), profit of ¥14.5 billion (up 42% YoY), and guidance for fiscal 2027. No transaction, special situation, or corporate event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring—is announced. This is a routine periodic earnings report and does not constitute a special-situation filing. No deal terms apply.
